text:
```yaml
name: Auto‑approve Copilot PRs

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  auto-approve:
    if: github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'github-copilot[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Auto‑approve Copilot PR
        uses: hmarr/auto-approve-action@v3
```
